claims.basis: Official PMR material identifies the 2013 Falcon FG, while Supercars and Albins technical sources establish the COTF transaxle and shift mechanism.

COTF and Albins sources establish the six-speed transaxle. The official COTF report discusses dog-ring wear in the control transaxle. The ST6 manufacturer documentation establishes sequential rod/cable activation and the COTF installation is the manual-stick system. The ST6 is documented as sequential. The six-speed sequential race transmission uses a driver-operated clutch for standing starts; no automatic launch system was established. The mandated shift-cut system is explicitly intended to reduce shift loads during rapid wide-open-throttle gear changes. The documented shift cut momentarily interrupts torque and supports wide-open-throttle upshifts. Official COTF documentation describes mandated shift-cut settings. Dog-ring race transmission construction supports clutchless downshift as the hardware baseline; exact driver technique remains reviewable. Dog-ring construction establishes the mechanism; manual rev matching is the derived downshift technique unless an automatic blip is separately established.
